methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The work presented in this chapter focuses on the modeling of the gas flow supplied to a boiler in order to implement a soft sensor.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: Paper designs a low-cost 'soft' (virtual) sensor that models boiler gas mass flow from the valve control signal, gas pressure and temperature (LPV and Gaussian-process models). This is a flow-measurement/instrumentation model, not an EnPI or EnB energy-performance-measurement model; ISO 50001 and IPMVP appear only as motivating context.

paper_type.evidence_quote: the design of new low-cost sensors in the following areas

stage1.notes: Model-rich, but the embedded model is a virtual flow-meter (soft sensor) for gas consumption, not an EnPI/EnB; ISO 50001/IPMVP only contextual. Borderline eligibility call — flag for human review.
